title: i18n(nl): re-sync index_nl.html with English Apr 28–29 rewrites
body:
`index_nl.html` was ~7 weeks and 370 lines behind `index.html` after four English commits (2e19c55f, ef06d712, 59ee742f, d8265e1e) rewrote the hero, added structural sections, and corrected SEO/JSON-LD.

## Structural additions (translated)
- **Live-platforms bar** — quick-links bar below hero CTA
- **Portfolio comparison table** — Riksdagsmonitor / EUPM / EP-MCP / CIA with OpenSSF + SLSA badges per row
- **Trust & verification statement** — "Verifieer, vertrouw niet: …"
- **Security badges** per product card (OpenSSF Scorecard, SLSA Niveau 3, CII Best Practices)
- **API / Docs deep links** in product card footers

## Content & metadata updates
- Title → `AI-Gestuurde Democratische Transparantie | Politiek Inlichtingenplatform | Hack23`
- `og:locale` = `nl_NL`; OG + Twitter title/description re-translated
- `hero-tagline` and `intro-tagline` now carry distinct Dutch text
- `#political-intelligence` card order: EP-MCP → CIA → Riksdagsmonitor → EUPM
- Counts: `62 MCP-tools`, `11 agentische workflows` everywhere (meta, JSON-LD, body)
- EP-MCP repo URL corrected; BT OG metric stuffing removed

## Invariants preserved
- All URLs, `href`, `src`, JSON-LD `@id` values — unchanged
- `inLanguage: "nl"` in JSON-LD; canonical `index_nl.html`
- 14-language hreflang block + `x-default` — byte-identical
- Footer language switcher (14 langs), Dutch marked `aria-current="page"`
- Final line count: **2538** (English: 2520, Δ = +18)
